[[File:Iron platelegs detail.png|left|90px]]
'''Iron platelegs''' are [[melee]] leg armour made of [[iron equipment|iron]]. There is no [[Defence]] requirement to wear them, as is the same with [[bronze armour]]. As such, it is recommended to skip bronze tier items and start out with iron tier items. They have the same defensive stats as an [[iron plateskirt]] but weigh more. 

They can be made at level 31 [[Smithing]] with 3 [[iron bar]]s, granting 75 experience.
